topics.label: Course introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic welcomes the students, introduces the lecture series, and outlines the core learning outcomes for the session.

topics.label: Biological basis of cancer in cellular regulation and tissue architecture
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer develops as a progressive failure of cellular differentiation, genetic regulation, and three-dimensional tissue architecture.

topics.label: Invasion, metastasis, and tumor classification
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how neoplasms are evaluated, differentiated, and categorized based on their invasive behavior, progression, and diagnostic nomenclature.

topics.label: Mechanisms of cancer morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the physiological and mechanical processes through which primary and metastatic tumors impair organ function to cause illness and death.

topics.label: Comparative incidence of tumors across tissues and species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics survey the relative frequency of different tumor types across human tissues and compare these patterns across other multicellular animal species.

topics.label: Principles and efficacy of cancer screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the clinical rationale, diagnostic methods, and comparative efficacy of screening programs designed to detect tumors before they become malignant.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and summary
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture by reiterating the learning outcomes and previewing the upcoming practical sessions.
